summary: AngioDynamics filed an 8-K reporting the filing of a patent infringement lawsuit against Endovascular Engineering (E2) regarding the Halo Thrombectomy System. No transaction, price, premium, or board recommendation is mentioned. The filing is a routine litigation update, not a special situation. The lawsuit seeks damages and equitable relief, but does not involve acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other event-driven categories.
